{{Checklist|
*Return to [[Veos]] in [[Port Piscarilius]] after speaking with all store owners. {{Chat option|4 Let's talk about your client...}}
*Use your [[Games necklace]] [[Wintertodt Camp]] teleport and run south until you reach the dark terrain with purple crystals, then east. Alternatively, if you have access to [[fairy ring]]s, use code {{Fairycode|CIS}}.
*Activate the [[Mysterious orb (Client of Kourend)|mysterious orb]] in your inventory while near the [[Dark Altar]], east of Trossa and north of the fairy ring.
*Return to [[Veos]]. {{Chat option|4 Let's talk about your client...}}
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
